key.name: view-remote-host
key.description: Display connections to remote hosts in the connection list. When enabled, network connections to addresses outside the local machine are shown.

key.name: view-local-host
key.description: Display connections to localhost (127.0.0.1) in the connection list. When disabled, connections to the loopback interface are hidden to reduce clutter.

key.name: view-local-address
key.description: Display local IP addresses in the connection list. When enabled, shows the local network interface address for each connection.

key.name: view-command
key.description: Display full command line arguments for processes owning connections. When enabled, shows complete command with arguments instead of just program name.

key.name: view-port-names
key.description: Display service names (http, ssh, ftp) instead of port numbers when the service is well-known. Uses /etc/services for name resolution.

key.name: view-unestablished-connections
key.description: Display connections in states other than ESTABLISHED, including LISTEN, SYN_SENT, SYN_RECV, FIN_WAIT1, FIN_WAIT2, TIME_WAIT, CLOSE, CLOSE_WAIT, LAST_ACK, and CLOSING states.

key.name: view-closed-connections
key.description: Display recently closed connections with fade-out effect. When enabled, connections that have closed are temporarily shown to track connection lifecycle.

key.name: view-colors
key.description: Use colors to highlight new and closing connections in the list. New connections are highlighted to draw attention, and closing connections fade to indicate state changes.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main application window in pixels. Valid range is 400 to 5000 pixels to ensure usability on various screen sizes.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main application window in pixels. Valid range is 300 to 5000 pixels to ensure usability on various screen sizes.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window is maximized to fill the screen. This state is restored when the application is restarted.

key.name: auto-refresh
key.description: Automatically update the connection list at regular intervals. When enabled, network connections are polled periodically to reflect current system state.

key.name: auto-refresh-interval
key.description: Time between automatic connection list updates in milliseconds. Lower values provide more responsive updates but increase CPU usage. Valid range is 100ms to 60000ms (1 minute).

key.name: auto-refresh-interval-menu
key.description: Widget ID of the menu item corresponding to the currently selected refresh interval. Used to restore menu checkmark state. Valid values are menuAutoRefresh1 through menuAutoRefresh7 corresponding to predefined refresh intervals.

key.name: filtering
key.description: Apply text filter to connection list. When enabled, only connections matching the filter expression are displayed.

key.name: filter-case-sensitive
key.description: Perform case-sensitive pattern matching when filtering connections. When enabled, 'HTTP' and 'http' are treated as different strings.

key.name: filter-operators
key.description: Allow AND/OR boolean operators in filter expressions. When enabled, complex filter expressions can be constructed using logical operators with proper precedence rules (AND before OR).

key.name: filter-text
key.description: Current filter expression applied to the connection list. When filter operators are enabled, this can contain complex boolean expressions. Otherwise, it performs simple substring matching.

key.name: sort-column-index
key.description: Index of the column used for sorting the connection list. Valid values correspond to column indices: 0=Protocol, 1=Local Host, 2=Local Address, 3=Local Port, 4=State, 5=Remote Address, 6=Remote Port, 7=Remote Host, 8=PID, 9=Program Name, 10=Program Command.

key.name: sort-direction
key.description: Sort order for the connection list. Valid values are 0 for ascending (GTK_SORT_ASCENDING) and 1 for descending (GTK_SORT_DESCENDING) order.

key.name: columns-order
key.description: Array defining the visual order of columns in the tree view. Each element is a column index specifying the position of that column in the display. Default order is: Protocol, Local Host, Local Address, Local Port, State, Remote Address, Remote Port, Remote Host, PID, Program Name, Program Command. The array must contain exactly 11 unique values from 0 to 10.
